# Regression test for the if-multi-child variable collision.
#
# When an `if` body contains more than one statement under a single parent
# slot, every child rendered into the *same* `<innerVar>` and prior children
# would be clobbered. Worse, any child that itself emitted
# `<innerVar>Children` (every container does) collided with its sibling and
# the generated Go failed to compile with "redeclared in this block".

# Post-Plan-C the fyne emitter's window-body path doesn't synthesize the
# reactive-if slot scaffolding (no `__renderSlotN`, no per-child inner
# vars). Lowering produces the right CreateNode/If shapes, but the legacy
# renderStmt() in compiler_ir.go drops them on the floor.
#
# Tracked alongside compile_fyne_component_fields: rewrite renderStmt to
# consume lowered IR via WalkLowered.
skip 'fyne reactive-if inside window emits no slot scaffolding post-Plan-C'

sngl compile --platform=fyne --lang=go --opt=main=true --out=out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

# Each child of the if-body must get its own indexed slot variable.
grep 'contentC0InnerC0 fyne\.CanvasObject' out/model.go
grep 'contentC0InnerC1 fyne\.CanvasObject' out/model.go
grep 'contentC0InnerC2 fyne\.CanvasObject' out/model.go

# The pieces are bundled into a VBox so the if-slot stays single-CanvasObject.
grep 'contentC0Inner = container\.NewVBox' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
output { go { fyne } }

component main {
    var visible = true

    window #app(title="t") {
        vbox {
            if visible {
                text(value="A")
                text(value="B")
                text(value="C")
            }
        }
    }
}
